description: Implementation of the f1u_bearer_impl class handling F1-U bearer logic, including PDU handling, SDU processing, discard management, and timer operations.

classes.name: f1u_bearer_impl
classes.description: Class managing F1-U bearer operations including PDU handling, SDU processing, discard management, and timers.

methods.name: f1u_bearer_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the F1-U bearer with configuration, timers, and notifiers.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Handles incoming PDU messages, attempting to enqueue or drop based on queue state.

methods.name: handle_pdu_impl
methods.description: Processes a PDU message, updating metrics, handling T-PDU, and data delivery status notifications.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDU, attaching it to a message, setting retransmission flag, and notifying PDU.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Queues an SDU for discard, managing discard blocks and timers.

methods.name: fill_discard_blocks
methods.description: Attaches discard blocks to a message if any are queued.

methods.name: on_expired_dl_notif_timer
methods.description: Handles expiration of the DL notification timer, triggering discard block flush.

methods.name: flush_discard_blocks
methods.description: Sends accumulated discard blocks as a PDU and stops the timer.
